  • Method Details

    • setReadTimeout

      public void setReadTimeout(int readTimeout)
      Set the underlying HttpClient's read timeout (in milliseconds). A timeout value of 0 specifies an infinite timeout.

      默认值为系统的默认超时时间。

      See Also:
      • HttpRequest.Builder.timeout(Duration)

    • setReadTimeout

      public void setReadTimeout(Duration readTimeout)
      Set the underlying HttpClient's read timeout as a Duration.

      默认值为系统的默认超时时间。

      See Also:
      • HttpRequest.Builder.timeout(Duration)

    • createRequest

      public ClientHttpRequest createRequest(URI uri, HttpMethod httpMethod) throws IOException
      描述从接口复制：ClientHttpRequestFactory
      Create a new ClientHttpRequest for the specified URI and HTTP method.

      返回的请求可以写入，然后通过调用 ClientHttpRequest.execute() 来执行。

      Specified by:
      `ClientHttpRequestFactory` 接口中的 `createRequest`
      Parameters:
      uri - 用于创建请求的 URI
      httpMethod - 要执行的 HTTP 方法
      Returns:
      已创建的请求
      Throws:
      `IOException` - 在发生 I/O 错误时
